values.Design: Metallic Balloons with Happy Birthday Banner
values.Description: Make every celebration unforgettable with the WishWorks Black & Gold Birthday Decoration Kit. This complete party set includes 30 black metallic balloons, 20 gold metallic balloons, a Happy Birthday banner and a balloon arch strip - everything you need to create a stunning backdrop in minutes. The balloons are made from high quality latex that holds air well and gives a rich metallic shine in photographs. Perfect for birthday parties, anniversaries, bachelorette parties, baby showers and festive home decoration. Easy to inflate with air or helium, and simple to arrange using the included arch strip.
Key Features: Complete kit of 50 metallic balloons with banner and arch strip
Rich black and gold metallic finish that is photo friendly
Easy DIY setup with the included balloon arch strip
Suitable for birthdays anniversaries and baby showers
Can be inflated with air or helium
